title: MASEMiner — TAS-20
tagline: Extract TAS-20 factor loadings, inter-factor correlations, and study metadata for MASEM
description: TAS-20-tuned MASEMiner variant.  Pre-fills the scale name, item count (20), max factors (5), and the standard three-factor mapping (F1=DIF, F2=DDF, F3=EOT).  The verbatim item texts are NOT shipped (TAS-20 is copyrighted) — paste them into the in-app builder if you have them.
task_description: Extract TAS-20 factor-analytic data: item-level factor loadings, inter-factor correlations, and study/sample metadata for every sample reported in the paper.
context: Papers report TAS-20 psychometric / factor-analytic studies. Standard three-factor structure: F1 = DIF, F2 = DDF, F3 = EOT.
